owner_names: 2024 Grantor Retained Annuity Trust of Susan Y. Kim dtd. 8/5/2024
footnote_text: On November 20, 2026, the Reporting Person distributed 1,082,000 shares of the common stock of Amkor Technologies, Inc. (the "Issuer") to Susan Y. Kim as a gift. Susan Y. Kim is the sole trustee of the Reporting Person. Because Susan Y. Kim is the annuitant and sole trustee of the Reporting Person, the distribution was a mere change in the form of ownership from indirect to direct and thus being voluntarily reported by the Reporting Person on this Form 4.
